outcome: Composite diagnosis of any thrombotic disease (pulmonary embolism [PE], deep vein thrombosis [DVT], cerebral vascular thrombosis [CVT], or other thromboses)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 2,361,711 pregnant and postpartum patients from the National Inpatient Sample database (2017-2019), with 9,983 having Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus.
finding: Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) is independently associated with an increased risk of thromboembolic events, including pulmonary embolism and deep vein thrombosis, during pregnancy and the postpartum period.
